Job Title: AI Engineer - Digital Engineering (Mechanical + GenAI/RAG)
Experience: 2 - 4 Years
Location: Pune


Job Description:
Are you a Mechanical, Aerospace, or Automotive Engineer who has successfully crossed over into AI/ML and Generative AI? We are looking for Digital Engineering Specialists who can bridge the gap between traditional physics-based engineering and cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence to advance technology solutions for next-generation industrial products.




This is NOT a pure Mechanical Design role, NOT a pure Data Science role, and NOT a generic Python Developer role. You will collaborate globally to explore advances in AI-in-Engineering technologies and evaluate their suitability for complex physical products.




Key Responsibilities:

Technology Exploration: Explore latest advances in AI/ML for engineering applications and evaluate their suitability for industrial products and systems.
GenAI & RAG Development: Design, build, and deploy LLM applications and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows tailored for technical engineering data.
Engineering Automation: Develop robust, hands-on Python scripts to automate design, simulation, and data extraction pipelines.
Global Collaboration: Work closely with digital design teams globally to advance engineering digitalization and implement solutions. Continuous Innovation: Participate actively in internal open innovation events, hackathons, and technology incubation within the team.
Process Compliance: Get trained on internal workflows, enterprise systems, and engineering processes to seamlessly execute projects.



Required Technical Skills & Competencies:

Engineering Fundamentals: Must have a strong basic understanding of Physics and core Mechanical Engineering concepts (Structural, Thermal, and Fluid Flow).
Advanced AI/ML: Hands-on experience with advanced Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) modelling methods.
GenAI Stack: Practical experience in developing and deploying LLM and RAG-based workflows.
Programming: Strong proficiency in writing Python-based scripts specifically for engineering automation.



Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills:

Basic knowledge of CAD tools: AutoCAD, Creo, Catia, NX, or SolidWorks.
Basic knowledge of simulation/analysis software: ANSYS, MATLAB, or Simulink.
Familiarity with alternative automation languages: VBA or C#.



Education: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Mechanical, Aerospace, Automotive Engineering, or a related domain with a proven track record in AI/ML engineering applications.




Interested?

Apply now or share your resume over saumya.trivedi@acldigital.com OR WhatsApp on 9879261206
